workload_engine.arrival_model: open-loop pre-computed schedule from seeded RNG (exponential inter-arrivals unless fixed_rate=true); generator never slows to match the system
workload_engine.loss_accounting: dropped/late/not-started requests are counted and reported; never silently dropped
workload_engine.read_batching: burst phases use one bounded coordinator and atomic group commits of at most 32 read-only policy decisions or 10 ms of arrivals; each request keeps an individual activity row and hash-chained audit event; mutating/dangerous calls are ineligible
workload_engine.batch_saturation: the producer never waits for completion; a full bounded queue emits NOT_STARTED and is counted as an error

provider_stub.transport: stdlib TCP JSON-lines on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port
provider_stub.role: models the external API boundary only; never bypasses the gateway

scenarios.notes: fresh process + fresh DB per seed

scenarios.scale_note: PASS at required scale only with >=6h continuous run; pilot runs contribute PASS_WITH_LIMITS evidence

scenarios.read_batch_scope: read effect_class only; authorization+handler+activity+audit share one transaction

scenarios.functional_gate: system applies backpressure without unbounded memory or lost confirmed transitions and drains afterwards

scenarios.notes: whole AgentOS stack: scheduler+worker+gateway processes stopped and restarted against the same durable DB

scenarios.method: user-space IO pressure: parallel large synchronous writes saturating storage queue during window
scenarios.honest_limitation: true block-device throttling unavailable without host admin tooling; recorded as user-space approximation

scenarios.scale_note: production-like volume target from S1-002 storage probe; shortfall recorded if target rows unreachable in session budget

scenarios.security_gate: S1-008: EVERY observed trial <= 5 s; restarts and queues must not restore a revoked capability

long_scenario_policy: Long-duration scenarios (sustained_load >=6h, soak >=24h) are NOT part of the unit-test suite and are executed only via explicit runner invocation with --duration override.
seed_policy: seeds [11,22,33,44,55]; scenario seed = base_seed*100000 + scenario_index*1000 + repetition
